link.title: Build a drone in Rete
link.description: A quadcopter built step by step in the Rete editor, with a picture after every step: number sliders for its sizes, a carbon frame with hexagon vents, two modules (one that repeats a part evenly around the drone, one for an arm with its motor, propeller, bolts and light), code components for the detailed parts, a canopy with a honeycomb, sprung landing legs and a camera, every part in a group with a comment. The finished drone is the Rete showcase.
